data.exact_reserve_text: In 2016, there has been an overall improvement of GBP 1.6m (2015: improvement of GBP 16.4m).

prior_year_events.impact_description: impacted by a number of smaller US weather events, mainly attributable to the Property division, increasing overall impact in profitability
continued positive development in the Energy book which has seen a lower level of large losses
Aviation book continued to be impacted by market losses during the calendar year, and following unsustainable rate reductions

named_events.loss_description: unprecedented level of small weather events which include record Hailstorms in Texas
unprecedented level of small weather events which include unprecedented flooding in Louisiana
Hurricane Matthew which impacted the primary insurance markets more than the reinsurance markets

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reported an overall net improvement (release) of GBP 1.6 million in its prior year claims provisions for 2016. This release was influenced by continued positive development in the Energy book from 2015. However, the 2015 year of account was impacted by smaller US weather events, particularly in the Property division, and the Aviation book continued to be affected by market losses from 2015 and 2016, leading to the decision to exit this market. The 2014 year of account closed with a profit of GBP 28.4 million, which was at the upper end of its forecast range, indicating favorable development for that specific year.
raw_causal_phrases: continued positive development in the Energy book
increased level of weather related losses
ongoing competitive pressure in premium rates
market losses during the calendar year
unprecedented level of small weather events
Competition in the marketplace continues to increase
pricing pressure is most severe in short tail books in particular the Property, Marine & Energy divisions
cost of acquiring the business has increased

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development is reported as a net figure of GBP 1.6m. No gross prior year development figure was explicitly stated or calculable from the provided claims development triangles, which showed zero movement for prior years when comparing current estimates to previous diagonals. The percentages for 'Rest of Europe' and 'Rest of the world' in the geographical premium mix table on page 11 were incorrect in the document and have been recalculated based on the provided amounts.
